On success, you will see a series of "PASS" messages, followed by "TEST COMPLETE".

obj.childAtIndex(0).childAtIndex(0).childAtIndex(0).role = AXRole: AXListItem
obj.childAtIndex(0).childAtIndex(0).childAtIndex(1).role = AXRole: AXListItem
